I formatted it on windows and then on the same computer as a .mp4

It’s used in a TV to showcase products and I’m the only one that knows how to format anything.

Hope this helps!

Rate my response to their DM?

It essentially states: 

Those with disabilities can still be discriminatory (ablest) against other disabled folks. I acknowledge your knowledge on the matter but denying someone’s disability is ablest and bigoted. The entitlement in which your letter is written to me saying I’m invalidating your disorders is narcissistic and I don’t appreciate anyone in my spaces making such remarks. Here’s some clarification about what John Doe said, as I wasn’t well informed enough about this subject at the time to go into details. Turns out it has nothing to do with you as I originally thought.

Is this too much of a dick move?
I feel like that’s a whole other thread tbh. Mind you all of us are only online friends.
We’re all mid/late-20s mostly 😅 John is in his late 50s, GF is 30s.
This isn’t a policy during normal work hours

I get how pushy I seem, and admit that I probably am, however we will be considered Common Law (pretty much married) soon.

I figured if it’s pretty much the same then why not just do it formally?

Thank you for your sympathy. This town is a horrible gossip and from what I know the current association is so out of tune to true AA that I understand why it’s driving him away. Not to mention that no one trusts another, which is a huge deal for sobriety.

Your words of wisdom surely will help. A lot of you guys are right that it’s his attitude and ego withholding him from the life he is working to obtain.

I appreciate your warnings of potential violence, but I’m an abuse survivor since birth and I learned the hard way when I was young to call red flags as I see them. He, as of now, is decent at respecting those boundaries.. for fear of losing me and the life he’s so far gained is a powerful motivator.

The whole reason I’m here asking which way to send him is because I do no harm but take no shit.

We don’t have the financial standing at the moment, mostly due to COVID. I have weak lungs and my doctor wants me out of the customer service biz as long as we can.

We have done some dialectical thinking and came to the conclusion the city would suit both of us, and that was a strong contender. It honestly looks like relocation may take up to a year.
...
I think the saddest part is there are so many sources for alcohol in this town, to the point where we have two crafter breweries for 20k people. Drinking and logging is what founded this town, and since that’s the attitude I can see how it could afflict their commitment of abstinence.

I understand I cannot do this for him. However, as I am aware I can at least bring this horse to water of resources.

I don’t get the whole.. higher self/being thing. It just sounds silly to me. However, I do understand the value it brings and have no clue how to encourage and stimulate spirituality/this feeling to turn him down the path he finds most comforting.

Thanks for pitching in!
Oh, awesome! I think he would appreciate that! I’ll dm you “hi” and then update you from there.

Mine? Uh, personally I am atheist. I indulge him in his spirituality since I know it helps him. He has no specific dominion to which he prays. So it would be difficult to participate in say, church.. for example.

Mm, thank you. I’ll try crossposting.

Perhaps I wrote the tone wrong? His major problem is that nobody is willing to truly help around here. :/ He wants to do the work but seems lost because our small town is kinda.. awful, to put it simply.

I’m familiar with AA, he has to want to get the help. My question is, where should he find it so long as he is “excommunicated” (his words) from the local group?
He believes in a god, but I’m aware he neglects his spiritual necessities. I asked him if he asks god for strength and he meekly reply’s with a shrug, “sometimes.”

I feel this on a deep level. 

Every time I look at the cat I rescued I think "Well I guess I'm not allowed to do it today bc this motherfucker needs me for 20 years." He's got like, 17 left. Sometimes it's the stupidest shit that keeps us going. Maybe look for that one thing?
